note: Parts as the builder constructs them, BEFORE the mandatory final mergeByMaterial. scripts/breads/baguette.ts adds one named mesh per leaf component (baguette-body incl. both pole caps and ear ridges, baguette-slashes = the 4 trench floors); mergeByMaterial then fuses them into 2 meshes because the consumer caps a bread at 2 materials / 2 meshes (scripts/breads/types.ts sections 1-2). Triangle counts are analytic from the station/sector grid classification (34 stations x 32 sectors, 4 slash footprints classified per vertex, triangles assigned by majority vote) and sum to 2048, matching the harness's reported total exactly.
